note: Deep exploration query set (2026-09-24). Separate from market-queries.json on purpose: that file is the calibrated archetype set whose control queries are asserted in scripts/validate-play-scan.mjs, and this set must be free to grow without touching those assertions. The 'controls' group below re-states one query with a manually known verdict (mushroom foraging guide = mixed, read 2026-09-23) so a run of this file can detect sensor drift on its own. Every 'why' here is a HYPOTHESIS being tested, never a finding.

archetypes.label: Trades and professions not yet measured
archetypes.why: The measured electrician field has a 5M+ install leader selling ads + IAP, which proves tradespeople buy tools. Only electrician, HVAC, concrete, welding and bolt-torque were screened, so the same archetype is largely unmeasured elsewhere.

archetypes.label: Field-service paperwork for non-developers
archetypes.why: Hypothesis: a job log a professional must produce on site is a job where the user would never build the app, and where the incumbent is often a paper form. Distinct from the calculator archetype because the value is a retained record, not a one-off number.

archetypes.label: Animal care as a professional or serious-hobby job
archetypes.why: Hypothesis: animal records are a repeat-use log kept by people whose identity is not software. The measured pet-medication field was mixed, not a fortress, so the parent category is not obviously saturated.

archetypes.label: Collections held by people who pay for them
archetypes.why: Hypothesis: a collector's inventory has real money behind it and a strong reason to record. The measured board-game and yarn fields were fortresses, so this archetype may be uniformly owned; it is included to test that rather than assume it.

archetypes.label: Caregiver and family care records
archetypes.why: The single 'candidate' verdict the factory has measured so far is assistive (visual schedule autism). This group tests whether the caregiver jobs around it are the same shape, while deliberately avoiding child-directed phrasings that trigger the Families policy question.

archetypes.label: Life-admin chores people dislike
archetypes.why: Hypothesis: paperwork people postpone is a job with an emotional reason to pay for help, and it is rarely served by a developer's own passion. The measured packing-list pocket passed the screen at a knife edge, so this family is not clearly empty.

archetypes.label: Food and drink craft logs
archetypes.why: Hypothesis: a craft hobby with measurable variables and repeat use. The measured recipe-scaling pocket was 'mixed' twice under different phrasings, which is the most stable pocket the factory has measured, so adjacent craft jobs are worth screening.

archetypes.label: Outdoors and radio record keeping
archetypes.why: Hypothesis: a licence or a sighting creates a record someone is obliged or eager to keep. The measured fishing-knot and mushroom fields disagree (fortress vs mixed), so 'outdoors' is not one market and must be screened query by query.

archetypes.label: Calibration controls
archetypes.why: Not candidates. A query whose verdict was read by hand on 2026-09-23 (mushroom foraging guide = mixed, score 68.8) is re-run here so a change in its verdict is readable as sensor drift rather than market movement.
